text:
```yaml
name: Check Discord Invite Link

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */12 * * *'  # every 12 hours
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  issues: write

jobs:
  check-link:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check Discord invite status
        id: check
        run: |
          CODE="f2AjwV2AN"
          STATUS=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://discord.com/api/v10/invites/$CODE)
          echo "Discord invite status: $STATUS"
          if [ "$STATUS" -ne 200 ]; then
            echo "INVALID=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "INVALID=false" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Create issue if link is invalid
        if: env.INVALID == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const label = 'discord-link';
            const { data: issues } = await github.issues.listForRepo({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'open',
              labels: label
            });
            if (issues.length > 0) {
              console.log(`An open issue with label '${label}' already exists. Skipping creation.`);
              return;
            }
            await github.issues.create({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              title: 'Discord invite link is invalid',
              body: `The Discord invite link \`discord.gg/f2AjwV2AN\` returned a non-200 status code. Please investigate.`,
              labels: [label]
            });
```
